text: Paid someone to add meta keywords to your website? Google stopped using them in 2009.
say: Paid someone to add meta keywords to your website? Google stopped using them in two thousand and nine.

text: Three SEO myths small businesses still pay for.
say: Three S E O myths small businesses still pay for.

text: Myth one: you have to pay Google to show up.
Google says it never takes money to rank a normal search result higher.
The paid spots are ads, and they're labelled Sponsored.
Myth two: meta keywords help you rank.
Google ignores that tag. Those hidden keywords do nothing.
What counts: a clear page title, like Plumber in Brisbane.
say: What counts: a clear page title, like, Plumber in Brisbane.

text: Myth three: repeat your keyword as many times as you can.
Google calls that keyword stuffing. It breaks their spam rules and can hurt your rankings.
Fix: say what you do and where, once, the way a customer would.
Which one have you paid for? Follow for more website tips.
